editorial.blurb: Kafecito is an affordable neighborhood spot serving up authentic Mexican comfort food and treats that keep locals coming back for more.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the staff directly what you want rather than relying on the unclear pricing postings—they're accommodating and will make it fresh for you, and don't miss their licuados and horchatas.

topDishes.note: refreshing and generously sized, exceptional value at $5 for XL
comes with fresh fruit, simple and satisfying
